items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Octave had a piece once with eleventh and thirteenths.

ctx.x: Did they use elevenths and thirteenths?

Did you use elevenths and thirteenths? Not much. But if you study and see what they are, they come to a natural card sometimes. A card is no good. Augmented and increased cards. Octave had a piece once with eleventh and thirteenths.
Octave used elevenths and thirteenths. Was this before depression? Was this before depression? Was this before depression?
